article.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.0 Breaks All Language Benchmarks
article.description: DeepMind's Gemini 2.0 surpassed every existing AI language model across MMLU, HumanEval, and reasoning benchmarks, reducing hallucinations by 60%.
article.author: Priya Sharma

article.title: India Launches National Quantum Computing Mission — Rs 6,003 Cr
article.description: The Government of India launched the National Quantum Mission targeting 50–1000 qubit computers within 8 years, positioning India among the world's top five quantum nations.
article.author: Rahul Verma

article.title: Cybersecurity Threats Surge 45% in 2025 — CERT-In Annual Report
article.description: India's CERT-In reports a 45% rise in cyber incidents. Ransomware attacks targeting healthcare and banking doubled, with AI-powered phishing as the most common vector.
article.author: Ananya Singh

article.title: Reliance Jio Launches 6G Pilot Network in Mumbai and Delhi
article.description: Reliance Jio began 6G pilot testing at terahertz bands, promising 1 Tbps speeds, with commercial rollout targeted for 2028 — ahead of the global ITU timeline.
article.author: Vikram Nair

article.title: Open Source Models Outperform GPT-4 on Code Generation — IIT Study
article.description: IIT Bombay confirms Llama 3.1 and Mistral-7B now surpass GPT-4 on code generation tasks in a 10,000-sample benchmark, democratizing advanced AI for all developers.
article.author: Dr. Meena Patel
